The quotation describes rolling out "Best Start Family Hubs" — a public service delivery infrastructure providing parental support, which is a welfare/child development program targeting families with young children.

Specific mechanism: community-based hubs delivering early childhood and family support services.

This falls squarely under I (Health, Education, and Welfare) — specifically child welfare and early childhood support services. There is a secondary dimension of public expenditure/provision (H), but the substance is the welfare service itself, not the fiscal instrument.

{"primary": "I", "secondary": ["H"]}
